A helicopter pilot lower down the mountain who was waiting to take the technicians back to McMurdo became concerned when they did not return to the aircraft at the appointed time. Researchers come to McMurdo to study subjects like the effects of climate change on ocean currents and glaciers, changes to marine ecosystems, and penguin biology and behavior.
